page_title: WOL 2-2 WER | Wolfsburg v Werder Bremen 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+3' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+3' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) will replace Rafael Borre.
90+2' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the free kick from distance, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
89' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen). A free kick has been awarded to Wolfsburg.
88' RED CARD! Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Tobias Reichel. He can have an early bath.
87' Substitution. Marvin Ducksch will be replaced by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
85' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Here is a change. Kevin Paredes is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
84' It's time for a substitution. Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) comes on in place of Joakim Maehle.
83' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
80' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.

78' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Wolfsburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
75' A cross from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
74' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) replacing Leonardo Bittencourt.
74' Here comes a substitution. Sebastiaan Bornauw is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolas Cozza (Wolfsburg).
73' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

73' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman makes the right call and Wolfsburg will have a corner.
72' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
71' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

71' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
68' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is caught offside!
66' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

65' 2 - 2 Goooooal! Mitchell Weiser beats his man and slings in a cross towards Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the bottom left corner from close in. 2:2.
63' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Reichel had an easy-decision to make.
59' 2 - 1 Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
58' Wolfsburg take a short corner kick.
57' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) replaces Mattias Svanberg.
57' It is time for a substitution. Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is on for Vaclav Cerny.
57' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Wolfsburg will take a corner kick.
56' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
56' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
55' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tobias Reichel stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

53' Wasted opportunity. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
52' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
48' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
47' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

45+1' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
40' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Michael Zetterer anticipates well and smothers the ball.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Joakim Maehle tees up Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
36' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off his line to gather the ball.
36' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.

35' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Pavao Pervan tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
34' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.
31' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
31' Pavao Pervan pulls off a great save to deny Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
30' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen will take a throw-in.
28' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
27' Tobias Reichel blows the whistle, Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul.
27' 59:41 – the ratio of ball possession.

25' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom right corner, but Michael Zetterer keeps it out.
24' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Wolfsburg.
22' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
21' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and Tobias Reichel immediately signals a free kick. Werder Bremen will take a free kick.
20' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
20' A pass lands at the feet of Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
18' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
16' A clumsy foul by Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle.
12' A spell of possession for Werder Bremen in an attempt to control the game.
7' 0 - 1 Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) curls in a direct free kick from beyond the box! His effort flies in off the right post, bouncing inside the net! A good exhibition of a strike!
6' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
6' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Reichel and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

5' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
4' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) trips an opposition player and Tobias Reichel signals a foul. Wolfsburg have a free kick.
3' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Wolfsburg will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Tobias Reichel.
